ops.title: project: general pack 0.27.0 / repo 10.2.0 (commit 0c91b39e, 2026-07-18, on origin/main) — rm guard rebuilt on rewrite_command_occurrences(visit=), blast-radius hard-denies (/, home, contains-repo) on the macOS trash path, check-only bash -c/eval descent
ops.body:
General pack **0.27.0** (repo CHANGELOG **10.2.0**, commit `0c91b39e` on origin/main, 2026-07-18): the rm guard on macOS rewrites recoverable risky deletes to the resolved `trash` binary, but now **hard-denies catastrophic targets** and **descends into nested shells**. Wave 1 was 0.26.0/9.29.0 (`ae212caf`). Full decision record: cc-notes ff6bcdbf; threat model doc 54548bc9; wave-1 blocker resolved in note c24ac338.

What wave 2 changed:
- **`blast_radius_block`** — three hard-deny tiers on the rewrite path (gated on `rewritable = trash is not None`, so non-macOS stays byte-identical at zero cost): filesystem root, home dirs (`Path.home()`/`/Users`/`/Users/<x>`), and any dir that `contains_repo` (bounded fail-closed 20k `os.walk`). `os.path.normpath`-normalized before the equality tiers (a trailing `..` was dodging them); tier order is equality-before-scan. This fixed the wave-1 blocker: `rm -rf /` and `rm -rf ~/Code` were trashing instead of denying.
- **`descend_rm`** — check-only descent into `sh`/`bash -c` payloads and `eval` (depth-capped `NESTED_COMMAND_DEPTH=3`, fail-open on depth/parse). A nested risky rm DENIES (never rewrites inside a quoted payload). `SHELL_C_FLAG = re.compile(r"-[a-z]*c")` catches combined clusters (`-lc`/`-xc`), not just `-c`. Closes `bash -c 'rm -rf /'`.
- **Rebuilt on the new `rewrite_command_occurrences(visit=...)` primitive** (public: `WalkContext`, `Rewritten` exported). VCS predicates → `captain_hook/util/vcs.py` (`in_vcs_repo`/`is_repo_root`/`scanned_names`/`contains_repo`); provenance emission + nested-shell helpers → `captain_hook/util/shell.py` (`emit_token` was `emit_target`, `plain_words`, `resolve_cd`, promoted `nested_command_string`/`safe_parse_command_line`), shared with the fixes-pack classifier.
- **cwd-threading made faithful** — a failed `cd /missing` (shell stays put) and a piped `cd` (`occurrence.piped`) no longer move the effective cwd.

Non-obvious state:
- **Glob >10 / too-broad globs deny on every platform BY DESIGN** (unchanged from wave 1). Refuter proved rewriting them trashes a repo root beyond the `limit+1` collection prefix. Don't restore without exhaustive match verification.
- **Two walk seams, never merge**: `walked_paths` (glob, dot-PRUNED, can't see `.git`) vs `scanned_names` (contains_repo, UNPRUNED). Distinct modules.
- **Tag `v10.2.0` NOT cut — push/tag is user-gated** (the PyPI release trigger; I don't cut release tags autonomously). Commit is on origin/main. `v10.1.0` was consumed by a concurrent performance-pack release (this checkout's HEAD `6fa82737` WAS the v10.1.0 tag; origin/main added a plugin.json sync on top), so the version jumped 10.1.0→10.2.0 — pick the release number from PyPI at ship time ([[concurrent-release-race-protocol]], [[capt-hook-release-rollout-gotchas]]).
- **Adversarial-framed review prompts ("BREAK this change") trip OpenAI's cybersecurity content filter and kill the codex run** — the clinically-framed finder passes on codex; refuter passes route to the Claude opus lane.
- **Deferred (backlogged, not fixed) — adversarial/upstream, not accident-shaped**: subshell `(cd X)` cwd leak (cc-transcript strips parens, `.piped` False — needs upstream occurrence subshell flag); wrapper option-arity (`sudo -u root bash -c`, `env -u FOO`; upstream `Command.unwrapped`, task d026e9c); case-insensitive APFS aliases; eval-cd side effects; string-concat `"rm"" -rf /"`. Plus family-level cleanups: flag-arity argv util, `binary_supports` probe, `Redirects` condition, per-arg raw/span upstream.
- **cc-transcript 14.0.0** is the baseline (Rust-native engine); `Occurrence.piped`/`prev_op`/`next_op` are the pipeline signals. Full pytest 3,691 passed on it; inline `capt-hook test` has 3 PRE-EXISTING failures (nudge_comment_to_cc_notes vc.yaml + 2× getaway.onboard) unrelated to this wave — backlogged separately.
- Emission soundness gates live in `emit_token`: `plain_words` = no quote chars in `Command.raw`; a backslash-newline continuation forfeits the rewrite; the trash path is shlex-quoted. All confirmed against the parser by execution.
